_owner: Finance and legal. Every figure on /tax-optimization comes from this file, and null hides it. Amounts are MINOR UNITS (cents); rates are BASIS POINTS (950 = 9.50%). program_fee can be published on its own; the calculator switches on when program_fee, income_tax_bands, employee_contributions, employer_contributions and months_per_year are all set ([] means 'none'). config/taxProgram.js documents each key and how Dynamics Hub's calculator maps onto them.
